message:
fix(ua2-apk r3): 'handled' is not 'switched'; the host's capability from one read of its role

Codex codex_ua2_apk_src_r2.md N1, N3.
N1: APPLIED only when what captures now (active) is the request. The host's policy using another in its place
(effective, DXGI quarantined) is POLICY_REPLACED; a request taken while the desktop still captures with another
(stored while idle, or a restart that fell back) is RECEIVED -- facts only, no cause the wire does not carry.
No request of ours and no host state yet (0 fields, NotYetApplied) stays CHECKING, not a confirmed idle.
The prelogon refusal stays terminal.
N3: ClientSessionController::DesktopBackendCapability() takes known and answers from ONE HostRoleGate load
(the same pong's flags); the JNI status uses it instead of two reads at two moments.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
